entries.text: 所有 SQL 在性能验证前都做 SQL 转换，消除变量导致的验证失败
entries.textEn: All SQL is transformed before performance validation, so variables no longer break it

entries.text: SAT 优化：支持同列常量比较的重写
entries.textEn: SAT optimisation: rewrites for same-column constant comparisons

entries.text: RuleOrCond4SelectRewrite 计算代价时排除关联条件
entries.textEn: RuleOrCond4SelectRewrite excludes correlation conditions from costing

entries.text: 过滤谓词下推不再下推 dummy 表达式与 explode 表达式
entries.textEn: Filter-predicate pushdown no longer pushes dummy or explode expressions

entries.text: dummy 表达式使用原始文本
entries.textEn: Dummy expressions keep their original text

entries.text: 优化 SATTC 在存在嵌套条件时的场景
entries.textEn: Improved SATTC with nested conditions

entries.text: 过滤谓词下推支持集合分支下推、单派生表下推与内外表下推
entries.textEn: Filter-predicate pushdown now covers set branches, single derived tables and both sides of a join

entries.text: 标量子查询解关联无论是否存在聚合都补上 group by 列
entries.textEn: Scalar-subquery decorrelation always adds the group by columns

entries.text: 使用 for xml auto 时不做标量子查询解关联
entries.textEn: No scalar-subquery decorrelation when for xml auto is used

entries.text: 按需限定 dummy 表达式
entries.textEn: Dummy expressions are qualified as needed

entries.text: 修复 RuleSelectSSQRewrite 的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed a defect in RuleSelectSSQRewrite

entries.text: 修复 SATTC 重写的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed a defect in the SATTC rewrite

entries.text: 修复 RuleSelectSSQRewrite 在出现同名列时的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed RuleSelectSSQRewrite with duplicate column names

entries.text: 分区表规则优化，提升健壮性
entries.textEn: Partitioned-table rules are more robust

entries.text: 「索引列上的运算导致索引失效」规则排除聚合函数的误报
entries.textEn: The index-invalidating-expression rule no longer flags aggregate functions

entries.text: 为 SQL Server 脚本添加违规所属行信息
entries.textEn: SQL Server scripts report the line of each violation

entries.text: SQL 对象携带行信息
entries.textEn: SQL objects carry line information

entries.text: 修复窗口函数反序列化的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed window function deserialisation

entries.text: 支持 OUTER APPLY 语法；性能验证前先格式化 SQL
entries.textEn: Added OUTER APPLY syntax; SQL is formatted before performance validation

entries.text: 修复因支持 DB2 导致的 interval 语法解析错误
entries.textEn: Fixed an interval syntax error introduced by DB2 support

entries.text: 新增 DB2 优化器支持
entries.textEn: Added DB2 support to the optimizer

entries.text: 新增 DB2 在线 DDL 解析器
entries.textEn: Added an online DDL parser for DB2

entries.text: 值表达式查找支持 GroupConcat 内的表达式
entries.textEn: Value-expression lookup covers expressions inside GroupConcat

entries.text: 修复冗余索引使用（indexusage）的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed redundant index usage

entries.text: 重复索引为唯一索引时不再建议删除
entries.textEn: A duplicate unique index is no longer suggested for removal
